B07N1GXM38.title: Lutron Caseta Smart Fan Control (Smart Hub Required) 4-Speed for Paddle Fan
bullets: ELIMINATE PULL CHAINS: This Lutron switch provides control of your ceiling fan right from the wall, choose from 4 fan speeds plus off, for increased comfort; works with AC fans, not DC fans
WIRELESS CONTROL: Pair this Caseta Lutron smart switch for fans with the Fan Pico remote (PJ2-3BRL-GXX-F01, sold separately) for wireless control from anywhere around your home

MOST CONNECTED: The Caseta fan control switch connects with more leading smart home devices, including Amazon Alexa, Apple Home, the Google Assistant, Ring, Serena shades and Sonos, than other smart lighting control brand (Caseta Smart Hub required)

CONTROL YOUR WAY: A Lutron Caseta fan control switch puts the smarts in the switch so you can control your ceiling fans - via the app, with your voice, or from the wall; create schedules that set speed or activate a scene (Lutron smart hub required)

EASY SETUP: Create a 3 way by mounting Fan Pico without cutting holes or pulling wire, with a Pico wallmount bracket (PICO-WBX-ADAPT sold separately); replace existing 3 way switches with a Lutron fan switch by mounting bracket over the backbox

B07NQDT39V.title: Lutron Pico Remote for Caseta Smart Fan Speed Control, 3 Button Control
bullets: Wireless: This handy remote allows for wireless ceiling fan control throughout your home when paired with the Caseta fan speed control (PD-FSQN-XX required)
Fan speed options: Choose from 4 fan speeds plus off for increased comfort; use center favorite button to save preferred setting

Adaptable: Add a point of control where you need one most; Pico fits within a standard decorator-style wall plate and mounts to almost any surface without wiring (PICO-WBX-ADAPT and wall plate required)
Long Life: Remote has typical 10 year battery life (battery included)
Includes: (1) Pico remote for fan speed control; fan speed control (PD-FSQN-XX required) and accessories sold separately
